meta.name: Information security

isms-security-officer.name: Information security officer
isms-security-officer.description: Sign off stocktakes and account reviews, manage shared accounts and account reviews, and read the register

isms-admin.name: Information security administrator
isms-admin.description: Everything in information security, including classes, sites and classification labels

settings.title: Information security settings
settings.description: Asset classes with their C/I/A scoring guidance, sites for asset numbers, and classification labels.

classes.hint: The class code starts every asset number of the class, after the site code.
classes.counts: {subclasses, plural, one {# sub-class} other {# sub-classes}} · {assets, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}}
classes.codeHint: 2–4 capital letters, such as HW. It can’t change later.
classes.codeFixed: The code can’t change: asset numbers carry it.
classes.guidanceHint: What each score means for assets of this class. People see it while they score an asset. Leave a level empty when it doesn’t apply.

sites.hint: The site code starts every asset number, such as HQ01 in HQ01HW0001.

labels.hint: Labels say how information must be handled. The most sensitive come first.
labels.rankHint: A higher rank means more sensitive; lists show the highest first.

register.title: Information assets
register.description: The information asset register: every asset with its type, owner and value (the highest of confidentiality, integrity and availability).

empty.title: No information assets
empty.none: Register the people, hardware, software, information and services your organisation depends on.

register.needClassSite: Choose an asset type and a site.

assetForm.hint: Name it, say who owns it, then score confidentiality, integrity and availability with the asset type’s guidance: the asset value is the highest of the three.
assetForm.ciaHint: Choose the highest score whose description fits, so the value isn’t underestimated.
assetForm.ciaPickClass: Choose an asset type to see what each score means for it.
assetForm.confidentialityHint: Impact if it is disclosed to people who shouldn’t see it.
assetForm.integrityHint: Impact if it is wrong, incomplete or changed without permission.
assetForm.availabilityHint: Impact if it can’t be used.
assetForm.nameHint: Describe what it does, simply and clearly.
assetForm.quantityInvalid: Enter a whole number, 0 or more
assetForm.numberHint: The asset number is made from the site and class codes and the next number, such as HQ01HW0001.
assetForm.numberKept: The asset number stays the same if the site or class changes.
assetForm.usersTextPlaceholder: For example: Finance department, all staff
assetForm.usersAndPlace: Who uses it and where it is
assetForm.classificationSuggested: Suggested from the confidentiality score: change it if this asset needs another label.
assetForm.classificationHint: The four labels follow the confidentiality scale: score 4 is the most restricted.
assetForm.usersTextHint: For people the platform doesn’t list, such as a department or a supplier.

import.assetsDescription: Check the file first: nothing changes until you import.
